name: R21 the game turns itself upright on a phone
description: held in portrait the game rotates 90deg and fills the screen instead of using 32% of it, with the touch zones following the picture; landscape cannot be forced on iOS and a rotate-your-phone card is useless under a rotation lock. Ceiling is on the GATE's basis (--O1, randomised roadroller search, 15-iteration zopfli), whose spread is ~70 bytes. The 13,312 limit applies to the submission basis (strands:ship, --O2): 13,289 best of three packs, and one pack in three now exceeds the limit - pack repeatedly and submit the smallest.
